name: The Girl With The Gray Hair Awakens
source:
A girl wakes up in a strange room, unsure of who she is...An atmospheric VN inspired by flash fiction and short stories that changes every time you play!

[From [url=https://heiden.itch.io/the-girl-with-the-gray-hair-awakens]Itch.io[/url]]

一个女孩在一个陌生的房间里醒来，不确定自己是谁……一款受短篇小说和短篇小说启发的大气VN，每次玩时都会发生变化！
